Toughpower GF1 650W - TT Premium Edition
The fully modular Toughpower GF1 series is available in 650W - 850W models and built
to deliver 80 PLUS Gold efficiency. The series features a 140mm hydraulic bearing fan, Japanese capacitors
and other premium components to help deliver a continuous and stable power with an ambient temperature up to
50°C, while near silent operation and reliable performance are guaranteed. With an ample 10-year warranty,
the Toughpower GF1 is able to satisfy the market, where PC enthusiasts are looking for a premium power supply
with all the latest features.
